Homepage branch cards — scroll instead of wrapping

Captured from the real homepage (live branch data). Only between about 780px and 970px wide do the cards scroll: one row, swipe or trackpad sideways, snaps to each card, thin scrollbar for mouse users. Laptop and desktop show all four; phones keep the stacked list.
Change: one CSS block in src/styles/bredesign.css (.bd-branch-grid, ~12 lines). Not touched: the cards themselves, the /branches page, phone layout, any text or data.

Tablet · 820px

Now: Imus drops to a row on its own. With scroll: one row, swipe or scroll sideways; Imus peeks in at the edge.

Small laptop · 900px

Same as tablet: one row that scrolls, next card peeking.

Laptop · 1024px

Now: wraps the same way. With scroll: all four fit, so nothing to scroll.

Desktop · 1440px

No change — all four already fit.

Phone · 390px

No change — cards stay stacked top to bottom.
